name: maqagr-local
description: MaqAgr local development environment — backend + frontend in one command

scripts.start:local: concurrently "cd backend && pnpm run start" "cd frontend && pnpm run dev"
scripts.postinstall: pnpm --dir backend install --frozen-lockfile --config.node-linker=hoisted && pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile --config.node-linker=hoisted
